a: Bank transfers can be delayed; design pending states and webhooks.
USSD sessions are short; keep menus shallow.
Treat BVN/NIN as highly sensitive PII with strict access controls.
Store amounts in kobo integers when using NGN.
Verify Paystack/Flutterwave signatures before trusting events.
Idempotency keys and unique business references prevent double charge.
Settlement may lag authorization; do not spend unsettled funds.
Keep evidence of delivery/consent for disputes.
Offline-ish agent networks need clear reconciliation processes.
Test transfers across multiple banks; behaviors differ.
